# `project.checks.set`

<!-- Generated by `cargo xtask docs-gen` from crates/ew-commands/schemas/project.checks.set.schema.json. Do not edit: change the source and regenerate. -->

`project.checks.set` (`SetCheckSchemes`): names the project's check schemes (doc 03 §15 `CheckSettings`): the
online scheme of the message panel (`active_scheme`, default `drafting`) and the scheme of the release gate
and `ew check` (`release_scheme`, default `pre-delivery`, doc 15 §3.2).

Both members are the new value: an absent one is removed from the settings member `CHECKS_MEMBER`, so the
default applies; the member's other contents (pack pins, strictness, members of newer formats) are kept, and
an empty member is removed. Each name must be a shipped scheme (`SHIPPED_CHECK_SCHEMES`; else invalid at its
pointer). Rejected: a settings member `CHECKS_MEMBER` that is not an object (a newer or damaged format).

**Exposure `HumanOnly`** (ADR-0008 amendment 3, ADR-0020): the release scheme decides which rules the release
gate runs, a check outcome, so only the GUI and a confirmed CLI subcommand may submit it; command logs,
scripts, MCP and plugins may not. Interactive: no printed value follows the scheme. Undoable as one step.
Outcome: none.

## Exit codes

A command runs as one line of a command log replayed by `ew apply` ([doc 17 §3.5](https://github.com/Ironkode787/ElektraWatt/blob/main/docs/design/17-extensibility.md#35-command-logs-ewcmd)). The exit code of `ew apply` is:

| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 0 | The line committed as one transaction. |
| 1 | A prevent rule or the command's own domain rule refused the line (`Prevented`, `Rejected`); without `--one-step` the lines before it stay committed and are saved, with `--one-step` nothing is saved. |
| 2 | Anything else stops the replay: invalid parameters, a missing record, an unresolvable reference, an open, lock or save error. |

The codes of every subcommand are in [doc 17 §3.2](https://github.com/Ironkode787/ElektraWatt/blob/main/docs/design/17-extensibility.md#32-exit-codes).

Exposure class `human_only`: [doc 17 §2.3](https://github.com/Ironkode787/ElektraWatt/blob/main/docs/design/17-extensibility.md#23-origins-and-exposure-classes) says whether a command log may run it.
